textwithimage.text:
Intel® Core™ i3/i5/i7 5000U (Gen. 5)

The TQ Minimodule TQMx50UC is a versatile COM Express® Compact Module designed to meet the demanding requirements of industrial and embedded applications. Powered by Intel® Core™ i3/i5/i7 5000U (Gen. 5) processors, this module offers outstanding CPU and graphics performance, enabling innovative features such as 3D scanning, gesture control, and voice commands. The integrated Intel® graphics core HD5500/HD6000 ensures a superior graphics experience and supports up to three independent display interfaces with resolutions of up to 4K.

With up to 16 GB of DDR3L onboard memory, fast interconnect options like PCI Express, SATA Gen3, USB 3.0, and Gigabit Ethernet with IEEE1588 support, this module is well-suited for high-performance industrial applications. Its unique features include a very precise industrial real-time clock (iRTC) and a comprehensive uEFI BIOS with Easy-Config, Multi-Setup, and Touch support.

The TQMx50UC is designed for reliability, with a 24/7 certification and a "Green ECO-Off" mode for minimal standby power consumption. It offers flexibility in system configuration and robust performance, making it an ideal choice for a wide range of FPGA-based engineering projects, where computational power and graphics performance are crucial.

text.text:
Features

  • CPU Performance: Powered by Intel® Core™ i3/i5/i7 5000U (Gen. 5) processors, this module offers reliable and efficient CPU performance suitable for FPGA engineering tasks.
  • Graphics Capabilities: Integrated Intel® graphics core HD5500/HD6000 provides support for multiple independent display interfaces with resolutions of up to 4K, essential for visualizing FPGA designs.
  • Memory Flexibility: The module offers up to 16 GB of DDR3L onboard memory, providing FPGA engineers with ample memory for working on large datasets and complex algorithms.
  • Comprehensive Connectivity: It features a range of connectivity options, including multiple USB ports, serial ports, Ethernet, and PCIe slots, ensuring seamless integration into FPGA development setups.
  • Industrial Reliability: Certified for 24/7 operation and designed with industrial-grade components, this module ensures reliability even in demanding FPGA engineering environments.

table.text:
CPU
  • Intel® Core™ 5000U series (Broadwell-U)
  • i7-5650U: 2x 2.2 GHz/3.2 GHz Turbo, 4 MB Cache, HD6000
  • i5-5350U: 2x 1.8 GHz/2.9 GHz Turbo, 3 MB Cache, HD6000
  • i3-5010U: 2x 2.1 GHz, 3 MB Cache, HD5500
  • Celeron® 3765U: 2x 1.9GHz/no Turbo, 2MB Cache, 5th Gen HD graphics
  • Hyper-Threading and Virtualization support
Memory
  • DDR3L - 4-16 Gb
  • EEPROM - 32kbit
Graphics
  • 2x Digital Display Interface/DP++ with up to 4K @ 60 Hz
  • LVDS Interface (18/24-bit, Single/Dual Channel), up to 4K (optional eDP 1.3 with 4 lanes instead of LVDS)
  • Intel® Quick Sync Video and Wireless Display support
Communications Interfaces
  • Ethernet - 1x Gbit Ethernet
  • USB - 8x USB 2.0 | 2x USB 3.0
  • Serial Ports: 2x Serial port
Other Interfaces
  • PCIe - 4x PCIe 2.0
  • LPC - LPC bus
  • I2C
  • SMBus
  • SPI - SPI (for external UEFI BIOS flash)
  • Audio - Intel HD Audio
  • GPIO - 8x GPIOthrough TQ-flexiCFG
  • SATA - 4x SATA Gen3
General
  • Dimensions - 95mm x 95mm
  • Plug-in System - COM Express Compact, Type 6
  • Temperature range - Standard temperature: 0°C…+60°C 
  • Power supply - 8.5 V - 20 V / 5 V Standby (optional) / 3 V battery/GoldCAP on carrier (optional)
  • Power consumption - Power: typ. 10 W/max. 18 W (Green ECO-Off: < 0.1 W)
